name: xlsx-viewer
title: XLSX Viewer
description: A virtualized Excel/spreadsheet viewer rendered entirely client-side: sheet tabs, zoom, download, formatted values, numeric alignment, sparse workbook storage, and row + column virtualization so huge sheets stay smooth. No useEffect for data loading.
